core.headline: Ex-local-authority mid-terrace house, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. The property is offered at a guide price of £285,000 freehold with no onward chain.

The ground floor comprises a lounge measuring 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). A lean-to utility adjoins the kitchen. The first floor has bedroom one measuring 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"), bedroom two measuring 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8") and bedroom three measuring 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approximately 9m (30ft) with a gate to the shared rear path. Parking is on-street with no permit required.

Gas central heating is installed with a Worcester boiler fitted in 2019. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage are connected. FTTC broadband is available.

Guide Price £285,000. Tenure: Freehold. Council Tax: Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating: C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
